opening.argument: The speaker stands before the Taj Mahal and discusses its founding and construction, including when its first stone was laid and how many people worked there. The on-screen text likewise refers to the monument’s foundations. Those observable details support a travel and historical account, not a request for money or personal information. The description does include a link for book orders, but it is presented as a separate product offer. Nothing in the supplied evidence connects that offer to deception, investment returns, a required payment, or a request for sensitive information. The commercial detail does not change the character of the historical commentary.

citations.quote: And in 1632, he placed the first stone on the location you see behind me to realize this dream. 20,000 people worked here for 21 years.
